candidate: the adopted stack (D48, 8,100 steps, three seeds per slot)

definitions.average: D58 is read on the mean over four families: dead ball carried; PFF; the three D24 views averaged; the two guard views averaged
definitions.edges: the full oracle's gain minus both sides' gains (corrections to the edges of found and real stoppages, and the non-additivity of spellF1)
definitions.found: one predicted stoppage covers at least half of the true stoppage
definitions.invented: a predicted stoppage that is not real
definitions.mostly_hidden: the ball is hidden on at least 80% of the stoppage's frames
definitions.offsets: predicted minus true start (stop) and end (restart) frame of the predicted stoppage covering a found true stoppage most
definitions.oracle_frame_reading: supplementary only: the full oracle's output only on true-D frames (add), or only on true-live frames (remove); together the full oracle
definitions.oracle_stoppage_reading: the full oracle's output only on the frames of missed true stoppages (add), or of invented predicted stoppages (remove)
definitions.real: at least half of the predicted stoppage lies inside one true stoppage
definitions.stoppage: a maximal run of D inside a graded half
definitions.union: side count only: found or real by the union of the other side's stoppages

reading.outcome: round 13 ends with the adopted stack

supplementary.note: not what D58 is read on (D58's amendments): the other one-sided split and the other average
